calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) mn, MAX(calendar_date) mx, MIN(fiscal_week) w1, MAX(fiscal_week) w2, COUNT(*) n FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period=5 GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, SUM(f.net_amount) net, SUM(f.gross_amount) gross, SUM(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat, SUM(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate) calc_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-02' AND DATE '2024-09-29'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_rl, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx, SUM(f.net_amount) net, SUM(f.gross_amount) gross, SUM(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat, SUM(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate) calc_vat, SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period=5
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dl, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id,f.line_no)) drl, SUM(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period=5 AND (s.store_id>=900 OR s.store_id=999)
GROUP BY 1

WITH a AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period=5 GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period=5 AND r.store_id<900 AND r.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE(a.store_id,b.store_id) sid, a.net, b.net, a.net-b.net diff FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.store_id=b.store_id WHERE a.net IS NULL OR b.net IS NULL OR abs(a.net-b.net)>0.005 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) off_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negnet, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) e1, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) e2, SUM(CASE WHEN f.vat_rate<>CASE p.vat_class WHEN 'reduced10' THEN 0.10 WHEN 'reduced14' THEN 0.14 ELSE f.vat_rate END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mism
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period=5

SELECT r.vat_rate, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dn, SUM(r.refund_net) net, SUM(r.refund_gross) gross, SUM(r.refund_gross-r.refund_net) vat
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period=5
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ROUND(100*f.vat_rate,1) AS vat_rate_pct, SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC
